top_rigor_problems: Engine cuts that turn into factual errors: removed sentences leave joins that misattribute or conflate. Answer 18 gives Nicaea's canon to Rome ('That is Rome claiming'), and answer 13 attaches Theodosius's 390 penance to the 386 standoff. The same cut shows up as orphans in 12 and 23.

The voice going past the records on dates and scope: answer 8 puts the Augustinian system in 'your later ages' although Augustine is inside the window, and answer 10 claims that nearly every voice is Rome's and that Rome dominated the councils.

Retrieval misses where a direct record exists: F1-P skips ijc.dw.room-for-hesitation, F3-T skips the Chalcedon fracture in ijc.force.chalcedon-failed-consensus, and F6-T skips Leo on condemnation and Augustine's compelled-to-come-in.
top_access_problems: Orphaned lead-ins from cut sentences ('It was more than a blessing. That claim was real', 'That day, he says', 'a new practice' never named).
System and build vocabulary leaking into speech ('a composite voice of Church and Empire across the window', 'evidence for the gravity itself', 'the voice's own premise', 'The world's institutions').
Copy-paste reuse across cells: F2-P repeats F2-I's opening paragraph verbatim, F4-I repeats F4-T, and set lines ('A century of councils spent itself...', 'We did not write devotional memoirs') recur.
world_summary.cost_note: Most answers are 130-280 words at about $0.02 each. The answers longer than their value are F3-I (581 words, about 360 beyond need, with the 140-word Ammianus quote), F2-E (492, about 280), F4-E (397, about 180), F2-P (345, about 170) and F6-I (313, about 110). Trimming these five cuts most of the excess output tokens. The rest are within about 70 words of need.
world_summary.go_live_view: Close but not yet. The world's record discipline is strong. Honest limits are held and well pitched (F4-P, F5-I, F6-E), the Homoian recentering and Callinicum are handled with real integrity, and 20 of 28 answers ship as they stand. The four blocks come mostly from mechanics, not bad records: sentence-level cuts to record text leave joins that misattribute (F4-E) or conflate events (F3-I), and two answers improvise beyond the records (F1-T on Augustine, F2-E's self-critique). The most valuable single fix is in the engine. When it shortens a doctrinal_witness or story text, it should drop whole thought-units, or rewrite the following sentence's referent, instead of deleting single sentences. That one change would clear two blocks and two fixes (F3-I, F4-E, F2-T, F5-P). After that, add a guard against reusing an identical paragraph across cells, and strip self-identification and build vocabulary.
